Name: Visible Fish - Water
Author: SamirBalaNet
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Visible Fish in the Water[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]See every catchable fish, jelly, and legendary fish swimming in the water — built from scratch for Stardew Valley 1.6+[/i][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]🇬🇧 English Description[/b][/size]

[b]Visible Fish in the Water[/b] renders realistic, animated sprites of the exact fish, jellies, and catchable items currently available in the water around you, dynamically matching the [b]location, season, weather, time of day, and your fishing level[/b].

Built from the ground up using Stardew Valley 1.6's native
[code]Data/Locations[/code]and
[code]getFish[/code]systems, this mod provides smooth performance, zero errors with custom modded items, and full support for special locations.

[size=4][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]100% Native 1.6+ Logic:[/b] Accurately displays only what you can actually catch right now — no Night Market submarine fish accidentally swimming at the beach![/*]
[*][b]Full Mines & Jellies Support:[/b] Displays floor-specific mine fish ([i]Ghostfish, Stonefish, Ice Pip, Lava Eel[/i]) as well as [i]River Jelly, Sea Jelly, and Cave Jelly[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Legendary & Extended Family Fish:[/b] Shows all 5 Legendary Fish and Mr. Qi's Extended Family fish swimming at their exact fishing spots whenever all requirements (season, weather, fishing level) are met.[/*]
[*][b]Mod Expansion Friendly:[/b] Automatically works with custom fish and maps from expansions like [i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i], [i]Ridgeside Village[/i], [i]East Scarp[/i], and [i]More New Fish[/i] without throwing
[code]NullReferenceException[/code]errors.[/*]
[*][b]Purely Visual:[/b] Does not alter fishing mechanics, catch rates, or mini-game difficulty.[/*]
[*][b]Built-in Translations:[/b] Includes English (
[code]en[/code]) and Portuguese (
[code]pt[/code]) out of the box.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration (GMCM)[/b][/size]
Supports [url=https://nexusmods.com]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (or edit
[code]config.json[/code]directly):
[list]
[*][b]Maximum Fish:[/b] Cap the total number of fish rendered at once (Default:
[code]350[/code]).[/*]
[*][b]Fish Density:[/b] Control how populated the water looks (Default:
[code]0.18[/code]).[/*]
[*][b]Draw Fish Shadows:[/b] Toggle subtle shadows beneath swimming fish.[/*]
[*][b]Show Legendary Fish:[/b] Toggle Legendary & Extended Family fish at their fixed spots.[/*]
[*][b]Show Jellies:[/b] Toggle River, Sea, and Cave Jellies in the water.[/*]
[*][b]Show Trash & Algae / Show Trash on Farm:[/b] Toggle catchable trash and seaweed.[/*]
[*][b]Hide Trash at Fishing Level 10:[/b] Automatically hide trash once you master fishing.[/*]
[*][b]Hide Eel-like Fish:[/b] Filter out long, snake-like swimming fish.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the
[code]VisibleFishintheWater[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]🙏 Credits & Inspiration[/b][/size]
Inspired by the original concept of [i]Visible Fish[/i] by shekurika, completely rewritten from scratch for Stardew Valley 1.6+ compatibility and stability.

[line]

[size=5][b]🇧🇷 Descrição em Português[/b][/size]

[b]Visible Fish in the Water[/b] exibe na água os peixes, geleias e itens pescáveis disponíveis exatamente onde você está, respeitando o [b]local, estação, clima, horário e seu nível de pesca[/b].

Desenvolvido do zero utilizando os sistemas nativos do [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b], o mod garante ótima performance, compatibilidade total com expansões e zero erros no log do SMAPI.

[size=4][b]✨ Funcionalidades[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Lógica Nativa 1.6+:[/b] Mostra apenas o que realmente pode ser pescado no momento (sem peixes do Submarino do Mercado Noturno aparecendo por engano na praia).[/*]
[*][b]Suporte Completo às Minas e Geleias:[/b] Exibe os peixes específicos de cada andar das minas ([i]Peixe-fantasma, Peixe-pedra, Pip de gelo, Enguia de lava[/i]) e as três geleias ([i]Geleia de Rio, Geleia do Mar e Geleia da Caverna[/i]).[/*]
[*][b]Peixes Lendários e Família Estendida:[/b] Exibe os 5 Peixes Lendários e os peixes da missão do Sr. Qi nadando nos pontos exatos quando você cumpre todos os requisitos.[/*]
[*][b]Compatível com Mods de Expansão:[/b] Funciona automaticamente com peixes e mapas de mods como [i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i], [i]Ridgeside Village[/i] e [i]East Scarp[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Apenas Visual:[/b] Não altera taxas de captura nem a dificuldade da pesca.[/*]
[*][b]Traduzido:[/b] Menu de configurações totalmente em [b]Português (PT-BR)[/b] e [b]Inglês (EN)[/b].[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]📥 Instalação[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Instale a versão mais recente do [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extraia a pasta
[code]VisibleFishintheWater[/code]para dentro da pasta
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[/*]
[*]Inicie o jogo pelo SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
